snippet.title: Ved : Journey beyond the cube - Game Title announcement - Coming 2025
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce our new game, "Ved: Journey Beyond the Cube," launching in 2025 on the Steam platform (Windows/Mac)!

🔍 What to Expect?
It's a journey where each puzzle leads you deeper into a meticulously crafted world brimming with secrets waiting to be uncovered.


👀 Follow Us for Exclusive Updates & Behind-the-Scenes!
Stay connected! Follow our page for the latest news and sneak peeks behind the scenes. Be the first to see how this mystical world comes to life!
